items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘戏称与安东内利20岁时的最大区别：“他会说意大利语！”
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥大奖赛之后，安东内利成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。这位意大利人打破了塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔保持的记录，维特尔在蒙扎赛道时曾表示，他很高兴看到安东内利打破这一记录，并认为记录就是为了被打破而存在的。

media.altZh: 维斯塔潘戏称与安东内利20岁时的最大区别：“他会说意大利语！” · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen jokes about key difference with Kimi Antonelli at 20: “He speaks Italian!”
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘开玩笑说，他与20岁的基米·安东内利的关键区别是：“他会说意大利语！”
马克斯·维斯塔潘以典型的风格回应了关于他与最年轻F1世界冠军之间最大区别的问题。更严肃地说，这位荷兰人欣赏基米·安东内利接地气的一面
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
在墨西哥大奖赛之后，基米·安东内利成为了F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。这位意大利人打破了塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔保持的记录，维特尔在蒙扎已经表示，他很高兴看到安东内利打破这个记录，并认为记录是用来被打破的。
根据当前超级驾照规则，要想进一步降低安东内利的记录（20年、两个月和七天），将是一个巨大的挑战，因为有人必须在一个青少年时期就夺得首个世界冠军。
所有这些都凸显了安东内利成就的特殊性，尽管在意大利人获得冠军之前，维斯塔潘给出了一个相当平淡的回答，当被问及究竟是什么让这位梅赛德斯车手与大多数年轻车手不同时：“更多的天赋。”
当被问及这究竟是否如此简单时，这位四次世界冠军继续说道：“嗯，这当然有很大帮助。当然，他从小就有父亲的正确指导。他的父亲对赛车了解得比普通父亲多得多，如果你的儿子又有巨大的天赋，这已经帮了很大忙。”
在马克罗·安东内利的指导下，自然也有梅赛德斯的支持和信任，这是安东内利本人经常强调的。车队负责人托托·沃尔夫始终支持他的车手，甚至在去年困难的时候也是如此，而且有经验丰富的彼得·邦宁顿等人在他身边工作，安东内利几乎不可能希望有一个更好的环境。
当被问及安东内利拥有什么特质是20岁的维斯塔潘自己没有的时，荷兰人带着一脸严肃地笑了起来：“嗯，他会说意大利语……”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、维斯塔潘、红牛车队、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯
除了维斯塔潘的意大利语词汇量远不如安东内利之外，这位红牛车手强调这两个情况根本无法比较。
“你不能比较。我17岁就开始参加一级方程式赛车，很长一段时间里我都没有驾驶过能够为我争夺冠军的赛车，”维斯塔潘说。“这显然是最大的问题，但基米在那个年龄就能取得如此好的成绩非常令人印象深刻。”
凭借这些话，维斯塔潘自然是在提及他在托罗罗索的起步以及他在红牛的前几年，那段时间尤其困难，因为雷诺引擎表现不佳。因此，维斯塔潘只能争取个人分站胜利，直到2021年，也就是他的第七个F1赛季，他才有机会挑战车手总冠军。
由于缺乏有竞争力的赛车，前几年的表现自然让人感到沮丧，但这也给了这位荷兰人一个相对远离聚光灯的机会来发展。根据维斯塔潘的说法，安东内利没有这样的机会，因为他直接加入了一支顶级车队。
“我认为去年在某些时刻对他来说很困难。但当然，你也会从中学到东西，这些事情也是成长的一部分。在一个新手的赛季中，这是正常的，”维斯塔潘说。
“当你为顶级车队效力时，一切都会受到更严格的审查。你无法真正远离聚光灯来发展，但他很好地处理了这一点，为今年做好了准备。他从本赛季一开始就表现得很好。”
除了安东内利作为一名车手的品质，维斯塔潘还认为另一个方面甚至更重要：这位20岁的意大利人作为一个人是如何表现自己的，以及他似乎不受名气的干扰。安东内利很接地气，维斯塔潘表示这正是他最欣赏的：“他只是一个普通人。他不会表现得像摇滚明星或超级巨星。他非常真诚。他有一颗善良的心，我真的很欣赏这一点。
detailEn: Max Verstappen jokes about key difference with Kimi Antonelli at 20: “He speaks Italian!”

Max Verstappen responds in typical fashion when asked about the biggest difference between himself and the youngest F1 world champion. On a more serious note, the Dutchman appreciates how down-to-earth Kimi Antonelli is
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Following the Mexico Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli has entered the history books as Formula 1’s youngest-ever world champion. The Italian has taken the record from Sebastian Vettel, who had already said at Monza that he would be delighted for Antonelli to break it and that records are there to be broken.

Under the current superlicence rules, it will be an enormous challenge to lower Antonelli's record (20 years, two months and seven days) any further, as someone would have to clinch a maiden world title while a teenager.

All of this underlines just how special Antonelli's achievement is, although Verstappen gave a rather matter-of-fact response shortly before the Italian secured the title when asked what exactly sets the Mercedes protege apart from most young drivers: “More talent.”

Asked whether it really is that simple, the four-time world champion continued: “Well, that certainly helps a lot. And of course, he's also had proper guidance from a very young age with his father. His dad knows a lot more about racing than the average father, and if your son then has a huge amount of talent, that already helps a lot.”

Alongside Marco Antonelli's guidance, there is naturally also the trust and support of Mercedes, something Antonelli himself regularly highlights. Team principal Toto Wolff has always stood by his protege, even during the difficult moments last year, and with the experienced Peter Bonnington among those working alongside him, Antonelli could hardly wish for a better environment.

When Verstappen is asked what quality Antonelli possesses that Verstappen himself did not have at the age of 20, the Dutchman raises a laugh by responding with a completely straight face: “Well, he speaks Italian…”
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Aside from the fact that Verstappen's Italian vocabulary is significantly less impressive, the Red Bull driver stresses that the two situations cannot really be compared.

“You can't compare it. I started in Formula 1 when I was 17, and for a very long time I wasn't driving a car with which I could fight for the championship,” Verstappen said. “That was obviously the biggest problem, but the fact that Kimi is doing so well at that age is very impressive.”

With those words, Verstappen is naturally referring to his start at Toro Rosso and his first years at Red Bull, which were particularly difficult because of the underperforming Renault engine. As a result, Verstappen could only fight for individual race wins and did not have the machinery to challenge for the title for the first time until 2021, his seventh F1 season.

Although the preceding years were understandably frustrating because of the lack of competitive machinery, they did give the Dutchman the opportunity to develop relatively away from the spotlight. According to Verstappen, Antonelli did not have that opportunity because he stepped straight into a top team.

“I think last year was difficult for him at certain moments. But of course, you learn from that as well, and those things also need to happen to grow. That's normal in a rookie season,” Verstappen said.

“When you drive for a top team, everything gets scrutinised more closely. You can't really develop away from the spotlight, but he handled that very well heading into this year. He was right there from the very beginning of this season.”

Aside from Antonelli's qualities as a driver, Verstappen considers one other aspect even more important: how the 20-year-old Italian conducts himself as a person and how he is seemingly unaffected by fame. Antonelli is down-to-earth, and Verstappen says that is what he appreciates most: “He's just a normal guy. He doesn't act like he's a rock star or a superstar. He's just very genuine. He has a good heart, and I really appreciate that.”

keyPointsEn: Vettel expressed his delight at Antonelli breaking the record.

items.titleZh: 安东内利墨西哥站险些因漏油退赛
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在墨西哥站书写了F1和意大利体育史上的辉煌篇章，凭借速度、稳定性和成熟度赢得了首个世界冠军。

media.altZh: 安东内利墨西哥站险些因漏油退赛 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli almost had to retire in Mexico due to an oil leak
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在墨西哥几乎因为漏油而不得不退役
现在看起来似乎是一个完美的周日，但结果可能完全不同。就在他首次获得一级方程式世界冠军的几圈之前，基米·安东内利因为漏油导致引擎受损，差点退役
在墨西哥，基米·安东内利为一级方程式和意大利体育史写下了辉煌的一章。他在一个以速度、全年的一致性和成熟度定义的赛季中赢得了他的第一个世界冠军
安东内利与刘易斯·汉密尔顿和马克斯·维斯塔潘一起庆祝冠军，后来他们在领奖台上将他抬起来，这个象征性的画面似乎捕捉到了一级方程式的现在和未来
然而，庆祝活动本可能呈现出完全不同的样子，因为安东内利在比赛即将结束前的几圈差点退赛。
在比赛的最后阶段，意大利人在他的W17赛车上遇到了动力单元问题，差点退赛，这是梅赛德斯副车队经理布拉德利·劳德在《高性能》播客中透露的。
劳德说：“比赛结束后，我们取下了赛车底部的地板，上面满是油。”
“油底壳开裂了，基米说他在比赛最后四圈时感觉引擎开始出现问题。所以，他几乎就在退赛的边缘，但赛车还是坚持了下来。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，安东内利，梅赛德斯
这是安东内利本赛季一直展现出的成熟的一个标志。当压力很大时，这位意大利人保持了冷静，即使他的终身梦想就在几圈之外。
从现实的角度来看，即使安东内利退赛，他也能赢得冠军。
为了在数学上保持冠军争夺战，汉密尔顿需要赢得比赛，这意味着需要找到超越维斯塔潘的方法。但由于长直道上MGU-K动力限制，一旦汽车超过一定速度阈值，超越几乎变得不可能。
然而，在墨西哥庆祝冠军，站在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘身边，给这个时刻增添了全新的意义。三位车手在一起的合影注定将成为本赛季乃至一级方程式历史上的标志性画面之一。冠军中的冠军。很难想象有比这更好的方式来为安东内利的首个世界冠军画上句号。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli almost had to retire in Mexico due to an oil leak

What now appears to have been a perfect Sunday could easily have ended very differently. Just a few laps from his first Formula 1 world title, Kimi Antonelli came close to retirement after an oil leak began compromising his engine

In Mexico, Kimi Antonelli wrote a remarkable chapter in both Formula 1 and Italian sporting history. He clinched his first world championship in a campaign defined not only by his speed, but also by the consistency and maturity he displayed all year.

Antonelli celebrated the championship alongside Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen, who later lifted him onto their shoulders on the podium in a symbolic image that seemed to capture both the present and the future of Formula 1.
Yet the celebrations could easily have looked very different, as Antonelli came dangerously close to retiring just a few laps before the chequered flag.

During the closing stages of the race, the Italian was forced to manage a power unit issue on his W17 and came close to retirement, as revealed by Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord on the High Performance podcast.
"We got the car back after the race and took the floor off the bottom, covered in oil," said Lord.

“The sump cracked and Kimi said he thinks about four laps to the end he could feel the engine just starting to struggle. So, he was right on the edge of retirement of the race and yet it held together."
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
It was another sign of the maturity Antonelli has shown all season. When the pressure was high, the Italian kept his cool, even with his lifelong dream just a few laps away.
Realistically, Antonelli would have wrapped up the title regardless, even if he had retired.

To keep the title fight mathematically alive, Hamilton needed to win the race, which meant finding a way to overtake Verstappen. A scenario that proved extremely difficult due to an MGU-K power limitation on the long main straight, which made overtaking nearly impossible once cars exceeded a certain speed threshold.

Yet, celebrating the title in Mexico, standing on the podium beside Hamilton and Verstappen, gave the moment a whole new meaning. The photo of the three drivers together is destined to become one of the defining images not just of this season, but in the history of Formula 1. A champion among champions. It would be hard to imagine a better way for Antonelli to seal his first world title.

keyPointsEn: Antonelli celebrated the championship with Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯如何在巴西大奖赛赢得F1车队世界冠军
items.summaryZh: 在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得首个F1世界冠军后，梅赛德斯有望在巴西大奖赛中将其车队世界冠军记录增加至第九个。本赛季至今，银箭车队已赢得19场大奖赛中的12场，领先积分榜。只有法拉利理论上能追上他们，但126分的差距是一个巨大的挑战。

items.originalTitle: How Mercedes can win F1’s world constructors’ title at Brazil GP
detailZh: 如何梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛赢得F1世界车队冠军
圣保罗站将是银箭队赢得2026年冠军的另一个机会
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
在墨西哥大奖赛中，基米·安东内利赢得了他的首个F1世界冠军后，梅赛德斯可以在巴西为其记录增添第九个车队冠军。
银箭车队在本赛季的前19场大奖赛中赢得了12场，这意味着他们轻松地领先了积分榜。只有法拉利在数学上才能追上他们，但考虑到126分的差距，这几乎是不可能的。
梅赛德斯在墨西哥有了一次夺冠的机会，但这需要他们取得1-2的战绩，同时法拉利得分不超过4分。这一次，差距意味着位于Brackley的梅赛德斯车队只需要在圣保罗至少比法拉利多出3分即可。
梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上赢得冠军的多种可能方式
两辆梅赛德斯赛车都进入了积分榜，并且排在法拉利之前
梅赛德斯车队以2-3或2-4的成绩结束，法拉利车队未能获胜
两辆梅赛德斯赛车均进入前五名，法拉利车队没有赛车登上领奖台
安东内利或拉塞尔进入前八名，两辆法拉利赛车均退赛
在赛季前19轮比赛中（不包括冲刺赛），梅赛德斯车队有10次得分比法拉利车队高出3分或更多。
安东内利接替汉密尔顿成为梅赛德斯英雄
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
2026赛季标志着梅赛德斯自1955年以来首次在没有刘易斯·汉密尔顿的情况下赢得世界冠军，年轻的安东内利站了出来。
车队负责人托托·沃尔夫说：“与刘易斯一起赢得的冠军绝对令人难以置信，收获颇丰。”
“我感觉我们所有人都是刘易斯历史的一部分，是这位最伟大的冠军的历史，多年以后我们还会回想起，‘我们曾与刘易斯·汉密尔顿一起成为世界冠军’。这对我来说是一个非常值得深思的事情。他是那个始终保持着相关性，并且在 Formula 1 之外也非常具有文化相关性的人。”
“那是一个非常特别的世界冠军头衔，我将终身铭记，而这一次是不同的。正如我之前说的，对我来说[基米]仍然是一个几乎没有在视觉上发生很大变化的孩子。”
“这真是太令人耳目一新了。我几周前试图联系他，说：‘基米在哪里？’基米为了他的生日，他在水上乐园。太棒了！只要我们都能帮助保持这种状态，他就与梅赛德斯紧密相连，这也是一件好事。”
额外报道由罗伯托·奇切罗和罗纳德·沃丁完成。
detailEn: How Mercedes can win F1’s world constructors’ title at Brazil GP
The Sao Paulo round will be another opportunity for the Silver Arrows to clinch the 2026 crown
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
After Kimi Antonelli earned his maiden Formula 1 world title at the Mexico Grand Prix, Mercedes can add a ninth constructors’ trophy to its record in Brazil.

The Silver Arrows have won 12 out of 19 grands prix so far this season, meaning they comfortably lead the championship. Only Ferrari can mathematically catch them, but that’s a tall order with a 126-point deficit.

Mercedes had a first opportunity to triumph in Mexico, but that required a 1-2 and for Ferrari to score no more than four points. This time, the gap means the Brackley-based outfit just needs to outscore the Scuderia by at least three points in Sao Paulo.
Non-exhaustive ways Mercedes can win the title at the Brazil GP
Both Mercedes cars finish in the points and ahead of the Ferraris
Mercedes finishes 2-3 or 2-4 and Ferrari doesn’t win
Both Mercedes cars finish in the top five, no Ferrari on the podium
Antonelli or Russell finishes in the top eight, both Ferraris retire
Across the opening 19 rounds of the season (discounting sprint races), Mercedes has outscored Ferrari by three points or more on 10 occasions.
Antonelli taking over from Hamilton as Mercedes’ hero
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
The 2026 season marks the first time Mercedes has won world titles without Lewis Hamilton since 1955, with the youthful Antonelli stepping up.
“The championships with Lewis were absolutely incredible and rewarding,” team principal Toto Wolff said.

“I felt that we all were part of Lewis' history, of the greatest champion, and that we would look back many years to come and say, ‘We've been world champions with Lewis Hamilton’. And this is something I'm very much still thinking about. He is one that stayed relevant and is very much culturally relevant beyond Formula 1.

“So that was very, very special championships that I will have for my whole life with me, and this one is different. As I said before, for me [Kimi] is still the kid that hasn't even changed visually a lot.

“It's so refreshing. I tried to get hold of him a few weeks ago and said, ‘Where's Kimi?’. Kimi, for his birthday, he's in the water park. Great! And as long as we can all help to preserve it, he's intertwined with Mercedes, and that's also great to see.”
Additional reporting by Roberto Chinchero and Ronald Vording

keyPointsEn: Mercedes has won 12 out of 19 grands prix this season, leading the championship.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔在法拉利的领袖之争
items.summaryZh: The Race回顾汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔在法拉利争夺车队核心地位的碰撞过程，墨西哥站的最新摩擦表明2026赛季重新打开了这一话题，但两人都尚未决定性地占据主动。
items.originalTitle: How the collision course between Hamilton and Leclerc was created
items.summaryEn: The Race reviews how the collision course between Hamilton and Leclerc at Ferrari took shape, noting that their latest fracas in Mexico showed 2026 has reopened the debate over who leads the team without either driver decisively seizing the initiative.
detailZh: 上赛季结束时，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在马拉内罗艰难的第一年，似乎已经回答了谁是法拉利在F1的领军人物这一问题。
汉密尔顿与夏尔·勒克莱尔在墨西哥的最新摩擦表明，2026赛季不仅重新打开了这一争论，而且尚未让其中一位车手决定性地占据主动。
F1车手就是这样成为事实上的领袖的。忘掉合同怎么写，也忘掉领队看似给予的恩宠与偏爱，如果你是更强的车手，车队就会围绕你凝聚。
这正是勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿决心抓住每个机会证明自己的原因。而这一局面需要车库两侧的形势发生明显变化才会形成。
第一个问题是勒克莱尔最初对2026年规格赛车感到挣扎。虽然年初有一段时间，制动问题放大了这一困境，但那是暂时的。
然而，他经常批评那些不奖励他风格的赛车，因为需要在动力单元部署和能量回收方面进行一定程度的工程优化以保持一致性。这导致他不得不以不那么直觉的方式驾驶。
“这些赛车迫使我们做职业生涯中从未做过的事情，”勒克莱尔说。
“车手的多面性始终是好事，因为在职业生涯中你必须驾驶不同的赛车，从而为你的驾驶增添工具，并能够应对每一种情况。
“而今年，尤其是比任何其他年份都更明显，我们驾驶的方式非常奇怪。”
“有时候这并不是我特别喜欢的事情，但我认为作为一名车手，从长远来看这会是有益的。”
勒克莱尔是适应上一代赛车要求最快的车手之一，尤其是在调整刹车风格方面，当时队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯花了更长得多的时间才掌握，但这一次他却遇到了困难。
然而，正如车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔所指出的，勒克莱尔在本赛季取得了显著进步。
瓦塞尔表示：“也许确实如此，在他的驾驶风格中，他习惯于在Q3多做一次额外推进，而在这些规则下，这并不总能奏效。”
“他在理解规则、赛车、如何跑得更快、如何调校赛车方面恢复得很好。
“这并不容易，因为我认为挑战是巨大的。在赛季初进行重置，当你过去20年一直以某种方式驾驶，说要稍微早一点踩油门，而我们现在说‘不，不再是那样了，现在你必须一次性踩下去’……
“我不想说这不是同一项运动，但方式不同了。这对每个人都是如此，我认为有时我们低估了他们面临的挑战。但在那段困难时期之后，他恢复得很好。”
在勒克莱尔经历这一过程的同时——需要指出的是，尽管他目前状态良好，但尚未达到自己的绝对最佳水平——汉密尔顿也取得了进步。
2025年，他对法拉利缺乏熟悉度，这让他举步维艰，并公开质疑自己的能力，但第二年则完全不同。这是造成当前局面的第二个因素。
“对刘易斯来说这很艰难——用这个词来形容可能都算轻描淡写了，”瓦塞尔在谈到汉密尔顿面临的挑战时说道。
“这很艰难，因为这是在迈凯伦-梅赛德斯以及随后梅赛德斯共20年之后（发生的）。我个人低估了这一跨越的难度。
并不是说我们做得更差或更好，而是我们只是做得不一样。这不仅仅是食物或天气的问题，每一个软件都不同，每一个部件都不同，他身边的人也不同。
如果你没有掌控好一切，你就会在桌上留下零点几秒的差距。
而在我们25年所拥有的竞争格局下——我记得是阿布扎比Q1，从P5到P15之间只差十分之一秒[勒克莱尔P5与汉密尔顿P16之间为0.231秒，编者注]——这意味着我们并未完全掌控赛车套件的每一个细节，我们也稍微偏离了赛季的轨迹。
我记得布达佩斯，查尔斯在Q2比刘易斯快十分之一秒，但刘易斯是P11[实际差距为0.247秒，编者注]，而最终查尔斯拿下了杆位。
这不是借口，也不是一个好理由，你必须排在所有人前面，但归根结底，我们谈论的是细节，我认为我们或许低估了文化的改变、他身边人员的改变、一切的改变。
汉密尔顿仍在上升，期待他在下赛季取得进一步收获是合理的。和勒克莱尔一样，他表现出色，但也知道还有更多潜力可挖，这应该会让他在2027年再次变得更强一些。
这两条轨迹已经形成了一条碰撞路线，尽管车队里所有人都会希望它不会从比喻变成现实。
这关乎两名车手，他们都在不断打磨在这支车队和这些赛车中达到最佳状态所需的一切，同时决心通过纯粹的表现让自己成为车队的焦点。
这对车队来说有时可能会分散注意力，甚至适得其反，但从旁观者的角度看却令人兴奋。而根据目前的证据，这场争斗可能会一直持续到2027年。
detailEn: At the end of last season, the question of who was Ferrari’s spearhead in Formula 1 had seemingly been answered by Lewis Hamilton’s difficult first year at Maranello.
The latest fracas between Hamilton and Charles Leclerc in Mexico underlined that 2026 not only reopened the debate, but hasn’t yet led to one driver or the other decisively seizing the initiative.
This is how F1 drivers become the de facto leader. Forget what contracts say or the perceived grace and favour of a team boss, if you are the stronger driver the team will coalesce around you.

That’s exactly why Leclerc and Hamilton are determined to assert themselves at every opportunity. And it required a significant shift of the landscape on both sides of the garage to create this scenario.
The first was Leclerc initially struggling with the 2026-spec cars. While there was a stretch early in the year when this was exaggerated by braking troubles, that was temporary.

However, he’s regularly criticised cars that don’t reward his style given the need to engineer in a level of consistency to optimise the power unit deployment and harvesting. That’s led to him having to drive in a less intuitive way.
"These cars are making us do things that we've never done before in our career," says Leclerc.
"Versatility of the driver is always a good thing because in a career you've got to drive different cars in order to kind of add tools to your driving and being able to manage every situation.
"And this year, particularly more than any other year, we are driving in ways that are very strange.
"Sometimes it's not something that I particularly enjoy, but I think as a driver, it will be beneficial in the long term."

Whereas Leclerc was one of the fastest to adapt to the demands of the last generation of cars, particularly in modifying his braking style in a way it took then-team-mate Carlos Sainz far longer to master, this time he has struggled.
However, as team boss Fred Vasseur points out, Leclerc has made significant gains through this season.
"It’s true perhaps that [in] his driving style he was used to doing an extra push in Q3, and this does not always pay off with these regulations," says Vasseur.
"He had a good recovery in understanding of the regulations, the car, how to be faster, how to set-up the car.

“It was not easy, because I think the challenge is huge. To do the reset at the beginning of the season when you spent the last 20 years [driving a certain way], saying you have to go on the throttle a bit earlier and we say ‘no, it’s not like this anymore, now you have to go on [it in] one shot’...

"I don’t want to say it’s not the same sport, but the approach is different. This is true for everybody and I think that sometimes we underestimate the challenge for them. But after this difficult period, he had a good recovery."
While Leclerc has been working through this process - and it’s important to note that while he is operating at a good level he is still not at his absolute best - Hamilton has also made strides.
In 2025, his lack of familiarity with Ferrari meant he struggled and publicly doubted his own ability, but year two has been completely different. This is the second factor creating this situation.
"It was difficult for Lewis - and that’s a small word [for it] probably," says Vasseur of the challenge Hamilton faced.
"It was difficult because [it came] after 20 years with McLaren-Mercedes and then Mercedes. I personally underestimated the step.

"It's not that we are doing worse or better, it’s that we are just doing differently. It's not just about the food or weather, every single [piece of] software is different, every single component is different, the people around him are different.
"And if you are not on top of everything, you leave on the table a couple of hundredths of seconds.

And with the field that we had in '25 - I think it was Abu Dhabi Q1 that you had one tenth between P5 and P15 [it was 0.231s between Leclerc in P5 and Hamilton in P16, ed] - it meant that we were not in the full control of every single detail of the package, and we lost a little bit the path of the season.
"I have in mind Budapest when Charles in Q2 was one-tenth faster than Lewis but Lewis was P11 [the gap was actually 0.247s, ed], and at the end Charles finished with pole position.

"It's not an excuse, it's not a good reason, you have to be in front of everybody, but at the end of the day, we are speaking about details and I think perhaps we underestimate the change of culture, the change of people around him, the change of everything."

Hamilton is still on the up and it’s reasonable to expect further gains next season. Like Leclerc, he’s performing well but knows there’s more to come, which should make him a little stronger again in 2027.
These two trajectories have created a collision course, albeit one that everyone in the team will hope doesn’t make the transition from metaphor to reality.

It’s about two drivers, both still chipping away at what it takes to be at their best in this team and in these cars while determined to make themselves the focal point of the team through outright performance.

It might be distracting and even counter-productive at times for the team, but it’s thrilling to watch from the outside. And based on the current evidence, this is a fight that could rage on into 2027.
keyPointsZh: 文章认为，决定谁是车队实际领袖的不是合同或领队的偏爱，而是更强的车手会让车队围绕自己凝聚。
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿因此都决心抓住每个机会证明自己，这一局面需要车库两侧形势发生明显变化才会形成。
keyPointsEn: The article argues that de facto team leadership is not decided by contracts or a team boss's favour, but by the stronger driver around whom the team coalesces.
That is why Leclerc and Hamilton are determined to assert themselves at every opportunity, a scenario that required a significant shift of the landscape on both sides of the garage.
